enso.advisory_text: 25 October 2026 : A strong to very strong El Niño is present in the Tropical Pacific. Forecasts predict that El Niño will continue until the first half of 2027 and may reach its peak before the end of 2026.                                                                                                                                                           (updated: 07 October 2026) Trunkline No.: (02)8284-0800  local 4920 and 4921

region2_forecast: At 3:00 AM today, the center of the eye of Typhoon "ROSAL" {CHAMPI} was estimated based on all available data at 280 km East Northeast of Itbayat, Batanes (22.0°N, 124.2°E) with maximum sustained winds of 155 km/h near the center and gustiness of up to 190 km/h. It is moving Northwestward at 15 km/h.
